newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese escudo slips vs mark, eyes central bank.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese escudo slips vs mark, eyes central bank.

text.p: The escudo weakened against the mark, pulled down by the Spanish peseta, with the market keeping a wary eye on the Bank of Portugal.
The escudo eased to 100.52/55 to the German currency against its 100.41/46 close on Monday.
"We are at levels which inspire some nervousness because of what the Bank of Portugal might do," said one operator.
Traders said that the Bank had intervened in the past at between 100.60 and 100.80.
